Subject: PO vs card — procurement follow-up & next steps

Hi Sarah — great to connect earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

Summary of what we heard:
- FinTechCo prefers a PO process for vendor spend > $50k; procurement team owns vendor onboarding.
- If we can sign through your cloud marketplace (MarketX), your vendor onboarding is much faster — fewer forms for AP.
- AP requires W9 + SOC 2 summary and normally 30–45 days for payment on net terms for PO. Credit card payments are allowed for pilot/POC purchases under $5k but require a corporate card on file.

Attachments: I’ve attached the preliminary quote and our standard W9 & SOC2 summary for your procurement review (filenames below).

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll send an SOW draft and a formal quote (attached).
2) If you want to move via MarketX, I can loop in our channel partner lead to expedite onboarding.
3) If you need to go PO, please confirm the exact procurement contact and any vendor onboarding portal URL so we can submit required docs.
4) Suggest a short procurement kick-off meeting next week (15–20 minutes) to align on timeline.

Files attached: Quote_Redwood_Standard_20261120.pdf, W9_Redwood.pdf, SOC2_Redwood_summary.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up after I sync with Legal on the SOW draft.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and for sending the docs. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- Confirmed: PO required for > $50k. For pilots under $5k, we typically use a corporate card; anything in between needs AP approval and may go either way.
- Marketplace (MarketX) is preferred when available because it bypasses some manual vendor setup steps. Do you publish the Redwood product there? If so, we’d like to evaluate that route first.
- Required docs for direct vendor onboarding: W9, SOC 2 Type II report (or summary + link to full report if hosted), and a copy of the standard contract (SOW + Master Services Agreement).
- Our procurement contact is procurement@fintechco.com (CC’d). They handle vendor questionnaires and onboarding portal submissions.

For next steps on our side: procurement will review the W9 and SOC2 summary this week. If you can provide the SOW + MSA (or a proposed SOW with MSA redlines), procurement will put together a vendor onboarding checklist and target a kickoff next Tue/Wed.

Thanks,
Sarah Ng
Head of Procurement — FinTechCo
sarah.ng@fintechco.com
